archetypes.name: pipeline-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The port replaces several bash contracts with Python code and should be checked for emitted KV parity.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the native review_pipeline.py control flow against the removed shell behavior. Focus on argument parsing, emitted KVs, prune-decision sidecars, and review-core status exits. Pay special attention to fail-open paths and all-pruned round handling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: embedded-plan-review
archetypes.rationale: Plan-review gzip assets are dynamically rewritten and can regress after shell deletion.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the plan_review.py asset rewrite for dispatch-plan-review-panel and plan-review-loop. Verify the decoded bodies no longer require deleted prune scripts and still preserve PRUNE_STATUS, PANEL_PRUNED_EMPTY, PRUNED_COUNT, PRUNED_COMBOS, and prune-decision.env behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
